##### Project general facts

Azizi Abraham by Azizi Developments is a contemporary residential tower with striking facades and a thoughtful design that combines aesthetics with functionality. The building rises above three basement levels, a ground floor, a mezzanine and three podium levels to sixteen residential floors and a roof. The collection offers studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, together with two- and three-bedroom duplexes and premium retail units at street level.

Residents enjoy a rooftop infinity pool alongside separate swimming pools for adults and children, a fully equipped gym, a sauna, a steam room and a shared jacuzzi for everyday wellness. A cinema, a billiards area, barbecue zones, children's play areas, relaxation areas and cycling and jogging tracks add variety, while a welcoming lobby, lifts, ample parking and round-the-clock security with video surveillance provide comfort and peace of mind.

Residences feature modern layouts, panoramic windows and interiors finished in light neutral tones, creating a comfortable atmosphere for both living and working from home. High-quality materials and well-proportioned living areas give every apartment a bright, practical character. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances and built-in wardrobes, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Jebel Ali is one of the leading business and logistics hubs of Dubai, home to Jebel Ali Port, the largest port in the Middle East, and the Jebel Ali Free Zone, where thousands of international companies are based. Residential neighbourhoods, community retail, cafes, schools and clinics sit close to the business district, giving residents a practical setting close to their workplaces.

Sheikh Zayed Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connect residents with the wider city, and the Dubai Metro Red Line serves the area. Ibn Battuta Mall is a short drive away, Jumeirah Lake Towers, Dubai Marina and Jumeirah Beach Residence are close by, and Expo City Dubai, Dubai Parks and Resorts, Palm Jebel Ali and Al Maktoum International Airport are within comfortable reach.

Jebel Ali offers freehold ownership to international buyers and some of the most accessible entry prices in western Dubai. A large working population in the free zone and the port supports steady demand from tenants seeking homes close to their workplaces. Continued infrastructure investment around Expo City Dubai and Al Maktoum International Airport underpins attractive rental yields and long-term value for investors.
